content.text: rested on the seventh day from all his work, Gen. 2:2 (Heb. 4:4; Mosiah 13:18; Moses 3:2; Abr. 5:2). Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work, Ex. 20:9 (23:12; 34:21; 35:2; Lev. 23:3; Deut. 5:13). Solomon … is yet young … and the work is great, 1 Chr. 29:1. men did the work faithfully, 2 Chr. 34:12. people had a mind to work, Neh. 4:6. work is great and large, Neh. 4:19. all our enemies … perceived that this work was wrought of our God, Neh. 6:16. all these things worketh God, Job 33:29. our fathers have told us, what work thou didst, Ps. 44:1. establish thou the work of our hands, Ps. 90:17. heavens are the work of thy hands, Ps. 102:25 (Heb. 1:10). idols are … the work of men’s hands, Ps. 115:4. no man can find out the work that God maketh, Eccl. 3:11. a time … for every work, Eccl. 3:17. God shall bring every work into judgment, Eccl. 12:14. Let him make speed, and hasten his work, Isa. 5:19. that he may do his work, his strange work, Isa. 28:21. I will proceed to do a marvellous work … and a wonder, Isa. 29:14 (2 Ne. 25:17; 27:26; 29:1; 3 Ne. 21:9; D&C 4:1). shall the work say of him that made it, Isa. 29:16. work of righteousness shall be peace, Isa. 32:17. we all are the work of thy hand, Isa. 64:8. I will work a work in your days, Hab. 1:5 (Acts 13:41). be strong … and work: for I am with you, Hag. 2:4.

six days in which men ought to work, Luke 13:14. do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work, John 4:34. Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work, John 5:17. What shall we do, that we might work the works of God, John 6:28. I must work the works of him that sent me, John 9:4. I have finished the work which thou gavest, John 17:4. if this counsel or this work be of men, Acts 5:38. worketh righteousness, is accepted with him, Acts 10:35. to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, Rom. 4:4. all things work together for good, Rom. 8:28. short work will the Lord make upon the earth, Rom. 9:28. For meat destroy not the work of God, Rom. 14:20. Every man’s work shall be made manifest, 1 Cor. 3:13. are not ye my work in the Lord, 1 Cor. 9:1. same God which worketh all in all, 1 Cor. 12:6. always abounding in the work of the Lord, 1 Cor. 15:58. death worketh in us, but life in you, 2 Cor. 4:12. faith which worketh by love, Gal. 5:6. let every man prove his own work, Gal. 6:4. him who worketh all things after … his own will, Eph. 1:11. according to the power that worketh in us, Eph. 3:20. work out your own salvation with fear, Philip. 2:12 (Alma 34:37; Morm. 9:27). it is God which worketh in you, Philip. 2:13. his working, which worketh in me mightily, Col. 1:29. study … to work with your own hands, 1 Thes. 4:11. esteem them … in love for their work’s sake, 1 Thes. 5:13. stablish you in every good word and work, 2 Thes. 2:17. if any would not work, neither should he eat, 2 Thes. 3:10. Make you perfect in every good work, Heb. 13:21. let patience have her perfect work, James 1:4. wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God, James 1:20. Father … judgeth according to every man’s work, 1 Pet. 1:17. I know thy works, Rev. 2:2 (2:9, 13, 19; 3:1, 8, 15). give every man according as his work shall be, Rev. 22:12.

work which shall be everlasting, 1 Ne. 14:7 (22:8). to work in all manner of wood, 2 Ne. 5:15. worship the work of their own hands, 2 Ne. 12:8. God worketh not in darkness, 2 Ne. 26:23. I am able to do mine own work, 2 Ne. 27:20. work all manner of fine linen, Mosiah 10:5. pour out thy Spirit upon thy servant, that he may do this work with holiness, Mosiah 18:12. Lord worketh in many ways to the salvation of his people, Alma 24:27. let this desire work in you, Alma 32:27. ye should work out your salvation, Alma 34:37. God doth work by means to bring about his great and eternal purposes, Alma 37:7. did work all kinds of ore, Hel. 6:11. night cometh, wherein no man can work, 3 Ne. 27:33. among the Gentiles … a great and marvelous work, 3 Ne. 28:32. shall say the Lord no longer worketh by revelation, 3 Ne. 29:6. Go to work and build, after the manner of barges, Ether 2:16. Lord worketh not in secret combinations, Ether 8:19. they did work all manner of fine work, Ether 10:23. thou workest after men have faith, Ether 12:30. different ways that these gifts are administered; but it is the same God who worketh, Moro. 10:8. doeth good, he shall work by the power and gifts of God, Moro. 10:25.

recompense unto every man according to his work, D&C 1:10 (112:34). not the work of God that is frustrated, D&C 3:3. my work shall go forth, D&C 3:16. desires to serve God ye are called to the work, D&C 4:3. desired that he might do more, or a greater work yet among men, D&C 7:5. doubt not, for it is … the work of God, D&C 8:8. Stand fast in the work wherewith I have called you, D&C 9:14. not suffer that they shall destroy my work, D&C 10:43. assist to bring forth my work, D&C 11:9. bring about my righteous purposes … in this work, D&C 17:4. beauty of the work of thine own hands, D&C 42:40. I will cut my work short in righteousness, D&C 52:11. I will hasten my work in its time, D&C 88:73. all things shall work together for your good, D&C 90:24 (98:3; 100:15; 105:40). Foreshadowing the great work to be done in the temples of the Lord, D&C 138:48. to take part in laying the foundations of the great latter-day work, D&C 138:53.
this is my work and my glory, Moses 1:39. in it I had rested from all my work, Moses 3:3.
